highlights_headline: The upcoming 4.150.8 servicing release corrects region buffer sizing and GPU texture handling in Skia m150.

bullets.detail: Corrects scanline-transition allocation for subdivided conics in SkRegion::setPath and rejects accumulation overflow, preventing a heap out-of-bounds write.

bullets.lead: Correct texture uploads and subset sampling
bullets.detail: Disables GLES-invalid RGBA uploads for BGRA textures interpreted as RGBx. Nearest-filtered texture subsets retain shader clamps where magnification or fractional mappings could sample neighboring texels, while preserving the touching-edge fast path for one-to-one integer-relative mappings.
